reviews.comment: She talks fast but is willing to re-explain any concept you may not have caught. She is very easy to reach if you need a bit of one-on-one learning. She provided as much leniency that was possible with this course and was very dedicated to helping any students who reached out. Tests are going to be hard so if you don't study you won't make it.

Professor Tiplady has been by far the best professor I've had at A&M so far. ACCT 229 at A&M is a class that is highly structured by the university so she didnt have much wiggle room to do things differently. And yet she went above and beyond to support her students and truly made a difference. If you have the choice to choose Tiplady, choose her.

Professor Tiplady was great! This was her first time teaching undergrad and she did a great job. She understands how challenging this course is and makes sure that you have all the available resources to succeed, and she is happy to go over prior quizzes and post her lecture notes on canvas. She is very easy to reach outside of class through email.
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class
